text:
Test Garlic Chicken

Meat
Prep: 10 min
Cook: 25 min
Serves: 4

Ingredients:
- 4 chicken breasts
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1 tsp salt

Instructions:
1. Mince garlic.
2. Heat oil, cook chicken 6 min per side.
3. Add garlic, cook 2 min more.
